content: Hino, mbaha tughendelele kuulongolo kyanalumu, mu mahundo ghaakamilite na kuleka kunyuma mahundo gha kandahi ya kya lilagho lya Kilisito. Kangi tukotoke kuhighala mu ghala mahundo gha kandahi yaghalinga kulipetula kubhukana na kutama kwanga kunyeleha Chgapanga na yakya kunhyubhalila Chgapanga,
na mahundo gha ubatiso na gha kuayupila bhandu kwa kubhayabhikila mabhoko, na gha uhyuko na toso ya manjubha ghoha.
Kwa kutenda habho twaaghendelela kukula na kukamala mu uhyubhalilo pakapala Chgapanga.
Kiyaha bhandu bhala bhayimanyite kala hoto ya kya Chgapanga, na kukingama hilibhi hya maha ya kunani kwa njila ya Nhuki ghwa Chgapanga,
na kumanya kya maha kukita lilagho lya Chgapanga ndo la maha, na kangi bhangumanya makakala gha utabhala ghwa Chgapanga mu nnima ghuupala kuhika,
na mbole bhakikiluka uhyubhalilo, yahotoleka ng'obhe kubhabhuyiha bhalipetule kangi, kiyaha bhangummangalila Mwana ghwa Mundu kya ubhili kwa likaho na kunnyuyuha pekupeku.
Kiyaha lutupi luukomelwa hula maghenda maghenda na kumela mimela yinakupapa mapambiko kwa nkandakanda, lutupi alwo lunonelwa na Chgapanga,
peni handa yimela mihomi na hitonamamba, kahone lumotelo, na lwaabhegha ugheghela na kukotolwa na Chgapanga na muuhiko lwayochwa mwoto.
Ena maapalo ghwangu hata bhula nubhatyekela kwa malagho makalipa, hata habho nenga mmegha na ulyaghilo kukita mungutenda gha maha ghaabhoneha kukita mulopoleghwa.
Kiyaha Chgapanga ndo ghwa maha, na ywombe kangukulungwa lihengo limulitendite na upalo ghumuubhonehite kwa kya mwene na lihengo limubhatendela bhandu bhake na kangi mungughendelela kubhatendela.
Twenga tungupala kila yumu ywenu, kabhonehe ubhinililo ghula ghula, ngati mmokole kumanya uhoto ghuutwihilikite ghwa ghula udumbilo mbaka kuuhiko.
Habhu nkotoke kubhegha atotoho, ngati mmeghe handa bhanakuhyubhalila na bhaabheghite na ulimbililo, na kuuhiko bhaakamuhwa yila naghilo ya Chgapanga.
Ghakalaghilite Chgapanga ndo ulyaghilo
Chgapanga pakanlaghilite Abulahimu, kakilapa kwa lihina lyake mwene, kiyaha kahone ywakabheghite nkulu kupitingana kwa ywombe, ywene kwa aywo kangahotolite kulapa,
Chgapanga kakilongela, “Kulyaghila ndaghunonela na ndaghupegha ubheleko ntangalo.”
Abulahamu kakilimbilila na habhu kakimokola kila kyakalaghilitwe na Chgapanga.
Bhandu paalapa angulapa kwa yumu ywakabheghite nkulu kupitingana bhene, na kilapo kinguyomola malimbano ghoha.
Naywo Chgapanga kakiyimiha naghilo yake kwa kilapo, na kwa kya akyo kakiabhoneha peku peku bhala bhaabhalaghilite kukita kahone kupotongana kila kyakalapite,

Hinu Chgapanga kakihitenda ahi hilibhi hibhili, naghilo na kilapo, hyene hyahotoleka ng'obhe kugilimbuka na kwa ahyo Chgapanga kahotola ng'obhe kulongela uhwangi. Kakitenda hilibhi ahyo hibhili ngati katuyonjokehe mwoyo twenga tuntughilite ngati tughukamulile udumbilo ghwa milando yiipala kuhika.
Tubhegha na lidumbilo alyo handa kipaghiko kya kukamulila meli. Na lidumbilo alyo linguyingiha mbaka pahapa palapabhaghulitwe ya kya Chgapanga ghweka kuhyeto ya lipazia pakunani.
Yesu mwene kalongolela kuyingila amwo kwa kya twenga na kabhegha Ndundame Nkulu mu manjubha ghoha kya nga uhiko, handa undundame ghwa Melikisedeki.
